name: fastraml-viewer
description: A reference consumer of `fastraml tree` output.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run layers && npm run smoke
scripts.ci: tsc --noEmit && npm run layers && npm run smoke && npm run build
scripts.sample: cd .. && uv run fastraml tree -w fixtures fixtures/sample/api.raml > viewer/public/api.json
